newsitem.title: FRANCE: French court approves extradition for ETA suspects.
newsitem.headline: French court approves extradition for ETA suspects.

text.p: A French appeals court approved on Wednesday the extradition of two suspected members of ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom) detained since March 1992.
They are Jose Maria Arregui Erostarbe and Francesco Mugica Garmendia.
The court delayed its judgment on a third suspect, Ignacio Etchevarria Martin, to April 30.
Spanish investigators have linked Erostarbe to a booby-trapped parcel which injured Fernando de Mateo Lage, president of Spain's anti-terrorism court, in February 1990.
Mugica Garmendia is suspected of illegal association with a terrorist gang and of sending a car packed with explosives to Madrid in March 1991.
The French prime minister has to issue a decree for the extraditions to take effect.
ETA has killed more than 800 people in a 29-year fight for an independent Basque state encompassing parts of southern France and northern Spain.
